Cooking is the #1 cause of home fires. People forget to turn off the cooker or leave it unattended for too long. Sense will sound an alarm and notify the user with the app if the stove is left on or danger occurs.

If you have upgraded your Sense to control your cooker (with an optional Power Control Unit, available at www.safera.com), then it can also cut off the cooker power automatically, even if you are not at home or able to take action.

SAFERA CLOUD

Using Roroshetta App, you may link your Sense units to Safera Cloud. This enables remote alerts via SMS and/or E-mail, and data collection with visualization of your cooking statistics and air quality. It also enabled collaboration and event sharing between other 3rd party Cloud services.

FIRMWARE UPDATES

Whenever there is a new software update, Sense is updated over-the-air with the newest version of the App.
